tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250bdud rtsi lag mchod ni las byang gzhung gi bdud rtsi'i mchod pa phul ba'i rjes:1$0000300 hūm̐: gsung gi rdo rje rta mchog he ru ka: gsang ba kun 'dzin phyag na rdo rje la: rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: o rgyan grub pa'i rgyal po gzi brjid zhabs: ma hā rā dza che dang pra hastir: rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: go ma de wī pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: chos rgyal khri srong lo chen bai ro la: rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: zab gter mnga' bdag gru gu yang dbang gter: lung zin chos bdag brgyud par bcas pa la: rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: pad+ma khrag 'thung ye shes rnam rol che: byin rlabs mchog stsol rtsa ba'i bla ma la: rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: tshogs rje tshogs bdag dpal chen he ru ka: 'bar ba'i rgyal po khrag 'thung yab yum la: rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pra tīts+tsha ho: pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na: dbang gi rgyal po rta mchog dpal chen por: rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: rta mgrin sku la gnyis med lhun sbyar ba'i:

dbang gi yum chen pad+ma gzi ldan la: rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: mūṃ pad+me shwa rī pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: klu rnams ma lus gtan nas brlag pa'i phyir: mkha' lding rgyal po bya khyung ga ru ḍar: rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ga ru ḍa sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: srid gsum gdug pa thams cad 'dul mdzad pa'i: rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum 'khor bcas la: rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: gnyis med ngang du khro bo'i skur sprul pa: bcom ldan ya mān+ta ka yab yum la: rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ya mān+ta ka sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: dregs pa gdul dka' ma lus 'dul mdzad pa'i: tshogs rje tshogs bdag phyag na rdo rje la: rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba'i phyir: dpal ldan mgon po nag po yab yum la: rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā kā la sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro la: rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: badz+ra dhā ki nī sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro la: rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul:

thugs rjes cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: rat+na dhā ki nī sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro la: rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: pad+ma dhā ki nī sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro la: rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: karma dhā ki nī sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: phyogs bcu dregs pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng na: bdud 'dul khro bo chen po rnam bcu la: rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra kro dhā ma hā sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi thub par srung: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ma: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las so sor mdzad: mkha' 'gro sgo ma chen mo rnam bzhi la: rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥsarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: yab yum rdo rje pad+mar ldan byas te: byang chub sems kyi thig le dkar dang dmar: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i ye shes la: dus gsum bde gshegs rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs: yi ge gsum ni sku gsung thugs kyi ngang: de ring nyid du bdag la dgongs nas kyang: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ na mas+sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: oṃ na mas+sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka sid+dhi ā: oṃ na mas+sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: bdud rtsi'i dwangs bcud 'bru gsum gyi rnam pas bdag gi gnas gsum du thim ste/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par

bsam la bdud rtsis gnas gsum reg cing myang*/ hūm̐: rgyal ba mchod na dngos grub chen po stsol: rgyal ba mnyes byed bdud rtsi chen po'i mchog: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha tshogs kyi: thugs dam gnyan bskangs phrin las 'grub gyur cig: ces smon lam gdab bo//
